title: A Survey of Secure Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2604.08304v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, but this access path creates security risks distinct from inherent prompt-only or parametric-model flaws. We frame secure RAG as securing external knowledge access. We conducted a systematic search and curated 135 works on attacks, defenses, and security evaluation, and organized them with SLOT: a taxonomy along the attack Surface (S) and the corresponding defense Layer (L), with cross-cutting axes Objective (O) and attack-target scope (T). translated_title: 安全检索增强生成综述
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过引入外部知识来提升大语言模型（LLM）的能力，但这一外部知识访问路径带来了有别于纯提示或参数化模型固有缺陷的安全风险。我们将安全的RAG界定为保障外部知识访问安全的问题。我们通过系统性检索筛选了135篇关于攻击、防御与安全性评估的研究，并提出了SLOT分类体系对其进行组织：即沿着攻击面（S）与相应防御层（L）进行划分，并以目标（O）和攻击对象范围（T）作为横贯维度。将这些研究映射到外部知识访问流水线上后，我们揭示了三种错配：目标错配（T2攻击领先于T2防御与评估）、阶段错配（S1攻击数量远超L1防御），以及信号错配（流畅、可检索、贴合语料特征的S1攻击对基于异常检测的L2/L3防御构成挑战）。最后，我们讨论了迈向更现实的攻击目标、覆盖完整攻击面的防御以及安全性评估等未来研究方向。
tldr: 本文系统梳理了135篇安全RAG领域研究，提出SLOT分类体系（攻击面、防御层、目标与攻击对象范围），并揭示外部知识访问流水线中目标、阶段与信号三重攻防错配，为未来安全评估与防御指明方向。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically curates 135 works on secure retrieval-augmented generation, proposes the SLOT taxonomy (attack Surface, defense Layer, Objective, and Target scope), and reveals three mismatches—target, stage, and signal mismatches—in the external knowledge-access pipeline, outlining directions for realistic security evaluation and defenses.
